answer: The drop is real and line-wide: weekly mean CNT yield falls from ~27.5 to ~23.5 g/g-cat around weeks 13-15 (early June) in all four reactors. It is not one cause. (1) Catalyst lot/season step: lots FC-2602..2605 average 27.3-28.1, FC-2606/07/08 average 22.8-23.7; lots run sequentially with no overlap, and outdoor humidity climbs from ~55% to 70-95% from June, so lot and season are confounded. Yield falls with humidity overall (~28 at 50% to ~22 at >80%), but at the same humidity (60-75%) the later lots still look lower, so a lot effect plausibly adds to the seasonal humidity effect. Uptime is not a factor (no relation). (2) Equipment, R3 only: R3 falls much further (FC-2606/07/08 ~22/21.5/20 vs ~23-25 elsewhere; weekly ~20-21 vs ~23-24 for others from week 20) and R3 downtime jumps in Jul/Aug (~1.7-1.85k min vs 0.4-0.9k before), mostly heater failure plus nozzle clogging (Jul) and catalyst-feed faults (Aug). So: line-wide drop = lot change + humidity (cannot be separated with these plots); extra R3 shortfall = equipment (heater/nozzle).
